title: Looks inexpensive
text: Looks inexpensive. This container is bigger in person than it looks in the photos (pictured next to a 11-year-old boy, for reference). It's sturdier than I expected as well. But the construction isn't the best quality. The fabric was sewn in wrinkled and some areas and not pulled tight in others. Some areas the fabric is an even connected because the sewing machine ran out of thread, and whomever was stitching just kept going. The fabric is thin and I expect it would rip pretty easily too. I wouldn't repurchase this container, so I can't recommend it.

product_metadata.title: Niche Cubo Foldable Fabric Storage Trunk with Label Holder- Grey
features: STRONG AND DURABLE- Includes a reinforced bottom panel that adds an extra layer of stability. With the bottom panel in place, these bins are sturdy enough to use on their own to hold children's toys, towels, craft supplies, laundry and more.
EASY TO CARRY- Handles are sewn into the left and right sides of the bin which makes carrying and moving it easy and worry-free.
COLLAPSIBLE- Get rid of clutter and maximize your storage space! The reinforced bottom panel comes out and the entire bin folds flat for easy storage when not in use.

EASY STORAGE COMPARTMENTS: The removable center divider panel attaches with hook and loop strips to create two easy to use storage compartments. Or choose not to use the divider for one big compartment!
SPACIOUS AND VERSATILE: With a 30-inch wide and 15-inch deep interior containter space, store whatever you need, including clothes, toys, towels, linens and more.
description: Get organized with the Niche Fabric Storage Trunk! Strong and durable, these bins each include a reinforced bottom panel that adds an extra layer of stability. The bottom panel comes out and the entire bin folds flat for easy storage when not in use. A center divider attaches to the inside with a hook and loop strip, dividing the space into two easy to use compartments. Or you can choose not to use the divider and have one large storage trunk. The lid is hinged on the back so you can't lose it. The folding flap of the lid comes over the front of the storage trunk and closes with hook and loop strips for a secure uniform look. Two carrying handles make the entire storage box easy to move. Perfect for kids rooms, bedrooms, laundry rooms, playrooms, classrooms and more, make this Grey Niche Folding Fabric Storage Trunk a part of your home or classroom today!
